root_idea.summary: The root develops three principal orientations: a span or period of time, pressure that extracts what is within something, and attachment to a refuge or means of safety.
root_idea.development: The pressure sense extends to expressed liquid, extracted benefit or produce, rain-bearing clouds, and the whirlwind that raises dust; the temporal and refuge branches remain distinct lexical developments.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form عَصَرَ.
Displayed as the lexical noun/verbal noun إِعْصَار.
The Quranic feminine plural active participle is normalized to the supported singular citation form مُعْصِرٌ.

senses.definition: To press or squeeze something so as to force out its liquid or contents; to express or extract.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use includes expressing liquid from grapes or a similar substance. The displayed Quran forms are imperfect forms of this Form I verb.

senses.definition: To obtain or draw out produce, benefit, or livelihood.
senses.usage_conditions: In Yusuf 12:49, the expression is explained as obtaining the produce or good of the land; this is an extended extraction sense rather than merely the physical act of pressing.

senses.definition: To receive rain or be rained upon.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported alternative reading of the expression in Yusuf 12:49, not the ordinary QAC reading of the verse.

senses.definition: To be saved, preserved, or safe; to find refuge or protection.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported reading or interpretation of the expression in Yusuf 12:49. It reflects the associated refuge meaning and is distinct from obtaining produce.

senses.definition: To aid or succour one another.
senses.usage_conditions: Reported as another alternative reading of the expression in Yusuf 12:49.

senses.definition: A whirlwind: a violently rotating, dust-raising wind shaped like a pillar.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the whirlwind is described as containing fire. Classical explanations also associate the term with a wind that raises dust or lifts clouds.

senses.definition: Time, an age, or the enduring span through which generations pass.
senses.usage_conditions: In the oath in al-ʿAṣr 103:1, the word denotes time or the age as an extended temporal span.

senses.definition: A cloud ready to pour forth rain, or pressing rain forth.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the feminine plural مُعْصِرَات. Interpretations describe rain-bearing clouds; some explanations extend the term to winds that press rain from clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold, hinder, prevent, or refuse something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive usage meaning restraint or prevention; it may also describe withholding property or a benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or bestow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a contrary usage explicitly reported alongside the meaning “to withhold.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of grain: to put forth its glumes, enclosing and protecting the developing ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II agricultural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be contemporary with someone, or to reach the same time or period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person or period whose time one attains or shares.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the time of ʿaṣr, the afternoon or later part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal Form IV usage, also extended to entering the evening or last part of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl or woman who has reached the period of youth and puberty, or has approached or begun menstruation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical explanations vary between approaching puberty, attaining it, beginning menstruation, and, in one dialect, giving birth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become difficult, constrained, or intricate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V usage equated with becoming hard or difficult.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become compressed or pressed upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may describe something becoming squeezed so that its contents are forced out, or a rope or similar object becoming compressed against the throat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have recourse to someone or something for refuge, protection, preservation, or aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes the person or thing to which refuge or assistance is sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To void ordure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or euphemistic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swallow water little by little to help food lodged in the throat descend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction describing relief from choking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extract, extort, or take property from someone’s possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage can refer to taking property for a debt or another reason, or obtaining something from a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take back, revoke, or retract a gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of a father taking back what he has given to a child; the same discussions also connect it with withholding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be niggardly, avaricious, or tenacious in withholding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization of one who clings to property or refuses to give.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time or period of the day, especially the afternoon, evening, or another temporal extremity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to an hour, day, night, morning, afternoon, or evening; adverbial use can indicate coming late or not at the proper time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two temporal extremities, conventionally morning and evening, or more broadly night and day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact pair depends on the expression and authority; the term can also designate the first and last parts of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The afternoon prayer, and by extension its prayer time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name derives from its performance in the latter part of the day. العَصْرَانِ can also refer to the dawn and afternoon prayers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain issuing from the clouds called مُعْصِرَات.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived nominal usage distinct from the Quranic noun meaning time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man’s close paternal kin, clan, or agnatic group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for near relatives such as a person’s raht, ʿashīrah, or ʿasabah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of refuge, protection, concealment, lodging, or safety; a means of escape.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote either a physical refuge or a cause or means of safety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust raised and spreading, especially vehement dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe dust stirred up and dispersed, including dust raised by wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exhalation or waft of perfume.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in an idiom describing perfume or dust proceeding from a garment; the related expression may also refer to dust itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something from which water or another liquid can be expressed or nearly wrung out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: For example, clothing so saturated with rain that it is almost capable of being wrung out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Close kinship or a close relation, especially exclusive of more distant people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of relatives regarded as one’s immediate or nearest group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Expressed juice, extract, or liquid obtained from grapes and similar substances by pressure or squeezing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also denote the material extracted from things containing oil, syrup, honey, or moisture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dregs or residue remaining after a substance has been pressed to extract its juice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning refers to what remains rather than to the expressed liquid itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The choice portion or, contrariwise, the refuse of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources explicitly report both opposite applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The produce or yield of a land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from what is extracted or obtained from something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generous lineage, ancestry, or disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions describing children or a man of generous race, the word denotes the valuable “extract” or quality of a lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generous or liberal in responding to requests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in descriptions of a person whose bounty is readily obtained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protection that cannot be obtained, or a person whose protection is inaccessible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom based on the notion of obtaining an extract or benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who presses grapes, olives, oil, or similar substances to extract their liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The forms include an occupational noun and active participles; one usage specifies pressing for another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An extorter or exactor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative occupational extension of pressing or extracting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Three stones placed one upon another for pressing grapes and extracting their juice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun associated with the pressing apparatus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who takes property from his child without the child’s permission.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is specifically reported of a parent taking or controlling a child’s property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Origin, source, lineage, family, or inherited rank and nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can refer to ancestry and the reputation or quality derived from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An element from which material substances are composed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical philosophical usage, including the traditional four elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A device or receptacle in which grapes, olives, or another substance is pressed so that its liquid flows out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the press itself or to something into which the material is placed for pressing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or establishment in which grapes and similar substances are pressed to extract their juice or oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A location noun derived from the pressing action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tongue made dry by thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who gets or takes something from a thing or person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general figurative extension of extracting or obtaining; it need not imply coercion or property.

cautions: Yusuf 12:49 has multiple reported readings and interpretations: obtaining produce or benefit, receiving rain, being safe or preserved, and aiding one another. These are kept distinct from the ordinary QAC reading rather than treated as one undifferentiated gloss.

The Quranic مُعْصِرَات is a feminine plural form normalized under the supported singular active participle مُعْصِرٌ; explanations differ between rain-bearing clouds and winds associated with pressing rain.
